name: When considering a relist, what should I look for in a real estate agent?

mainEntity.name: When considering a relist, what should I look for in a real estate agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: When considering a relist, look for a real estate agent with a proven track record in luxury markets and experience with properties that require a fresh approach. Key qualities include strong negotiation skills, extensive local market knowledge, a robust network of high-net-worth buyers, and innovative marketing strategies. An agent who can articulate a clear plan for overcoming previous listing challenges is essential. Kelby Contreras emphasizes transparent communication and a data-driven strategy to effectively relaunch luxury properties across the South Florida regions served.
acceptedAnswer.description: When relisting, choose an agent with a proven luxury market track record, strong negotiation skills, and a clear plan to address prior listing challenges.
